note: The fixed agreement prompt set for the stage 1 CPU reference and the stage 2 and 4 chip check (issue 15). Stage 1 renders each prompt through the chat template, runs the CPU reference for the new tokens, and records the ids; the chip check compares its own tokens with those. The prompts are committed so a model and its control see the same text, and the set's sha256 is recorded with every result. The long prompt is made by orchard/agreement_core.py long_prompt_text(approx_tokens); a test keeps the file equal to it.
